      "evidence": "Extensively refactors CConnman in src/net.cpp and src/net.h, separating low-level socket I/O from Bitcoin P2P connection management and modifying peer eviction in src/net_processing.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.60,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Splitting socket handling out of CConnman is a major structural maintainability improvement for P2P networking tied to concrete future work like Stratum v2. While reviewers dispute whether the current abstraction cleanly decouples SV2 or HTTP, resolving the tight coupling between socket polling and P2P connection logic addresses a longstanding structural burden (#30694)."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only 4 lines in src/rpc/net.cpp as a mechanical consequence of CConnman interface changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The minor edit to src/rpc/net.cpp merely adapts callers to the CConnman refactoring without altering RPC behavior, interfaces, or server machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to fuzz harnesses and net tests follow directly from CConnman and SockMan signature updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to test utilities and fuzz targets adapt existing test coverage to the refactored networking classes rather than modifying general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "SockMan is placed in src/common/, but low-level socket polling and I2P SAM handling are networking concerns reviewed by net/p2p maintainers.",
